text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus ran with more brilliance than 
ever before. What brought out that power 
in her was, without a doubt, Hishi 
Akebono's presence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing her best friend for the first time 
filled Biko Pegasus's heart with a special 
fire. Flashing through her mind were the 
countless memories she shared with Hishi 
Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus reflected on the days she and 
Hishi Akebono spent pushing each other to 
greater heights. Their bond wasn't that of 
rivals—they were comrades who fought side 
by side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus declared that they should be 
heroes together, and Hishi Akebono took 
her hand. And so, the duo of heroes headed 
for the Mile Championship!
